mechanism.summary: Extend the existing false-prefix predicate scanner with a read-only present-own dense-array lease: it may retain unrelated holes outside the dynamic scan range while each accessed index is proven present own, and it reads primitive Number or Boolean values without entering the ordinary VM.
mechanism.generality: Admission remains derived solely from existing bytecode CFG/pure-read translation and run-time local/array state. The lease requires dense backing to cover logical length and no own special properties; each dynamic index is checked against the borrowed hole set before its value is read. A hole in the scanned range, accessor or descriptor, proxy, borrow conflict, non-primitive value, unsupported predicate, changed local, or any failed guard deoptimizes at the existing current-iteration boundary. No source path, function name, workload, input size, iteration count, checksum, or benchmark identity participates in admission.
semantic_risks: present own elements must continue to shadow prototype properties while a scanned hole must re-enter generic lookup so an inherited getter remains observable
own indexed descriptors and array storage borrow conflicts must decline before any scan iteration is committed
after a partial false prefix, the counter and false-branch completion state must be committed before the current hole, accessor, or non-primitive iteration is replayed by the VM
Boolean truthiness must be exact, and Boolean values must not be admitted into numeric-coercing predicate operations

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-28 /private/tmp/qjs-profile-access-nsieve-7c-v1.sample; exact pinned SunSpider access-nsieve source (SHA-256 ef62b42b6f926d61d9741a8e57b2758a9aea28ad2d1ee1e7d4747957d00fdc20) plus a profile-only repeated wrapper whose generated source SHA-256 is f81b05ee3bcbbc3be745cf86d92e2affb1a24261dc5cd2f01075494445b86efa, executed by the exact 6cac-equivalent release binary
profile_evidence.shared_cost: The outer sieve predicate has the existing pure false-prefix shape, but Array(m + 1) deliberately retains only indices 0 and 1 as holes after it writes Boolean flags from index 2 onward. The full-array dense lease rejects before touching the Boolean load, leaving virtual-object dispatch (626 exclusive samples, 17.0%) and generic loop/property work active across composite false entries. A present-own per-index proof removes that unrelated-hole blocker without changing the predicate bytecode or array write path.
